_comment: Real, untrimmed response captured 2026-09-21 via GET https://developers.lotto.pl/api/open/v1/lotteries/draw-prizes/Lotto/7407 with a valid secret header. The API returns a bare array; it is stored under `body` only so this comment can sit next to it. Items: Lotto, LottoPlus, SuperSzansa (drawSystemId null). prizes keys "1"-"4" = tiers I-IV = 6/5/4/3 hits; prize = number of winners, prizeValue = amount of ONE win in zł. Draws before 5048 (2011-08-25) come back with prizesEmpty: true and prizes: {}.
